summary: mem_capacity formula: (mem - 2048) / mem_per_fork, reserving 2 GB for other services with about 100 MB per fork, so a 4 GB node runs about 20 forks; mem_per_fork is SYSTEM_TASK_FORKS_MEM (default 100).
questions: How is mem_capacity calculated in automation controller?
How many forks can a 4GB controller node run?
How much memory does each fork need in AAP?

answer_card.title: Memory-based capacity (mem_capacity)
answer_card.answer_md:
Controller computes memory capacity as:

```
(mem - 2048) / mem_per_fork
```

2 GB is reserved for other services and each fork needs about 100 MB, so a 4 GB node gives `(4096 - 2048) / 100 ≈ 20` forks. Change `mem_per_fork` with the `SYSTEM_TASK_FORKS_MEM` setting (default `100`).
